title: Worker drones
summary: Drones build and repair. The Command Core makes more.
text:
Your **worker drones** do all the building. Place a building and an idle drone flies out to build it; with nothing left to build, idle drones repair damaged buildings (repairs cost alloys).

More drones build faster. Select the Command Core and tap **+ Drone** to fabricate one. The Core can run four at a time to begin with (research raises that).

- The ⛭ chip shows how many are idle: tap it, or press the full stop, to jump to the next one
- Drag from a drone to send it somewhere yourself
- Drones back away from predators unless you order them in
- If every drone is lost, the Core makes you a free one

Drones draw a little power, more when they're busy.
